title: lands-visual-accessibility
description: This is a client side mod that is an accessibility feature for the popular land claiming plugin Lands
body:
This is a client side mod that is an accessibility feature for the popular land claiming plugin Lands

You can customize the claim border colour as well as the thickness of the lines presented.  You can even allow the lines to pulse as well.

This mod aims to assist the visually impaired who struggle to see the claim border redstone dust particles.

[Lands Plugin](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/lands-%E2%AD%95-land-claim-plugin-%E2%9C%85-grief-prevention-protection-gui-management-nations-wars-26-x-support.53313/)
